title: After a suitable principal affine blowup a module that is free of rank r at the generic points of the closed fibres becomes free of rank r locally on the blowup
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma takes a ring R, an element f, an integer r, a finitely presented flat ring map R -> S with geometrically integral fibres, and a finite S-module M with M_f finitely presented which is free of rank r over S_q for every q = pS with f not in p, and it asserts that some finitely generated ideal I with V(f) = V(I) has the property that for all a in I and R' = R[I/a] the module M' = (M otimes_R R')/a-power torsion is locally free of rank r over S' = S otimes_R R', in the sense that at every prime p' of R' some g outside p'S' makes M'_g free of rank r (statement lines 8667-8691). The proof is announced as a generalisation of More on Algebra, Lemma labelled more-algebra-lemma-blowup-module and first reduces to M finitely presented: a finite submodule K of the kernel of a surjection S^{oplus n} -> M with S^{oplus n}/K iso to M after inverting f is produced from hypothesis (4), and the comparison map between the two a-power torsion quotients is an isomorphism because a is a nonzerodivisor on the modified module (proof lines 8693-8718). It then uses the Fitting ideal J = Fit_r(M), writes S as a direct summand of a free R-module by Lemma labelled lemma-fibres-irreducible-flat-projective-nonnoetherian, defines I' as the ideal generated by the coefficients of the elements of J and sets I = f I' (proof lines 8720-8732). The verification that V(f) = V(I) uses hypothesis (5) together with More on Algebra, Lemma labelled more-algebra-lemma-fitting-ideal-generate-locally (proof lines 8734-8744), and for a in I with a = f a' the Algebra lemmas on affine blowup and blowup with a principal generator give I'R' = a'R' with a' a nonzerodivisor, whence JS' is locally principal and More on Algebra, Lemma labelled more-algebra-lemma-principal-fitting-ideal generates M' by r elements locally (proof lines 8746-8762). The proof closes by killing the Fitting ideal Fit_{r-1}(M') using More on Algebra, Lemma labelled more-algebra-lemma-fitting-ideal-finite-locally-free and the containment S'_a inside a product of localisations supplied by Lemma labelled lemma-base-change-universally-flat (proof lines 8764-8779). Realising the right ideal I through coefficients of the Fitting ideal and then descending freeness from the Fitting ideal computation is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
